info.name: MyPortfolio REST API — Roles (COMP229 Assignment 3)
info.description: Run the folders in order. Set adminEmail / adminPassword (collection Variables tab) to the admin account created by `npm run seed:admin`. Sign-in saves {{userToken}} and {{adminToken}}; each create saves its id. Only records created by this collection are deleted, so it is safe to run on real data.

item.name: POST /api/users — sign up a regular user
POST /api/users — sign up a second user
POST /auth/signin — sign in as the regular user

exec: pm.test("Role is \"user\" (the role sent at sign-up was ignored)", () => pm.expect(data.user.role === "user").to.be.ok);

item.name: POST /auth/signin — sign in as the admin

exec: pm.test("No password hashes", () => pm.expect(users.every(u => !("hashed_password" in u))).to.be.ok);

item.name: PUT /api/users/:id — user updates own name (role change ignored)
POST /api/contacts — visitor sends a message (no sign-in needed)

body.raw:
{
  "firstname": "Jane",
  "lastname": "Doe",
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "contactNumber": "416-555-0123",
  "message": "Hi Colby, are you available for a Winter 2027 co-op interview?"
}

item.name: DELETE /api/contacts — remove all as user is forbidden (403)
DELETE /api/contacts/:id — admin deletes the second test contact
DELETE /api/projects — remove all as user is forbidden (403)
DELETE /api/projects/:id — admin deletes the second test project
DELETE /api/qualifications — remove all as user is forbidden (403)
DELETE /api/qualifications/:id — admin deletes the second test qualification
DELETE /api/users/:id — admin deletes the second test user
